name: Jasch Industries Ltd
tagline: Small-cap PU/PVC synthetic-leather maker (post-2024 gauging demerger) whose live inflection is now multi-quarter confirmed - Hyundai/Kia interior-fabric ramp drove FY26 revenue +24% / PAT +77% and Q1 FY27 revenue +54% YoY - but EBITDA margin is only ~7.6%, net debt has risen to ~Rs 19 Cr, there are no con-calls, and the stock has already re-rated +83% in six months to ~Rs 197 Cr mcap
business_overview: Jasch Industries (Sonepat, Haryana, Garg family-run, promoters ~57.6%) manufactures PVC/PU coated fabric (synthetic leather) for footwear (Puma, Red Tape, Bata), apparel lining and, since 2025, automotive interiors - it has started supplying coated fabric for Hyundai/Kia car interiors and has received regulatory approval to increase PU coated-fabric capacity (a ~Rs 28 Cr capex). The industrial electronic-gauge division was demerged into separately-listed Jasch Gauging Technologies (Feb 2024). (Source: external-lead, @StocksAndStoics, untrusted X triage, first_seen 2026-09-04 - grouped with Mayur/Premier Polyfilm as an 'artificial-leather trio' up 50-70% on the auto-demand cycle.)

fundamentals_narrative: A 'weak trailing average, strong live inflection' small-cap case that has now been confirmed for multiple quarters. Trailing 5yr sales growth was only ~11.2%/yr, but FY26 delivered revenue Rs 228.8 Cr (+24% YoY) and PAT Rs 13.25 Cr (+77% YoY), and Q1 FY27 revenue was up 54% YoY to Rs 75.26 Cr with PAT +73% - driven by a real, named catalyst: Jasch has started supplying coated fabric for Hyundai/Kia car interiors and has regulatory approval for a PU capacity expansion (~Rs 28 Cr capex). The community math (Kia's ~2.5 lakh vehicles/yr x ~10-12 m of leather cloth = ~25-30 lakh m of incremental demand, an estimated Rs 80-100 Cr) is now partly showing up in the numbers. A trusted user (Prabhat_Mohanty, Jun 2026) independently judged the improvement genuinely fundamental (topline-driven), not a forex one-off like peer Mayur's concurrent result. The caveats the deep read confirms: EBITDA margin is only ~7.6% (a price-taker coated-fabric business - the bull case is margin expansion from a thin base, not a defensible margin), net debt rose from ~Rs 4.5 Cr (Mar-24) to ~Rs 18.7 Cr (Mar-25) to fund the capex, Q1 FY27 revenue was flat-to-down sequentially, and the company holds no earnings calls - a genuine information-scarcity risk for a thesis this dependent on one OEM relationship. The stock has already re-rated +83% in six months.
technical_read: Not pulled - fundamentals/community catalyst math was decisive. Stock has run hard: +83% over 6 months, near the upper half of a Rs 126-344 52-week range. Tiny float (~0.67 Cr shares) means high volatility and thin liquidity.
sentiment_summary: 30-post thread spanning 2016-2026 (originally about the now-demerged gauging division's value-unlocking potential). Post-demerger (2024) activity has focused entirely on the coated-fabric business: PE/margin comparison vs Mayur (2024), the Kia contract build-out and community revenue math (Apr-May 2025), a strong Q4FY25 result confirmation, and a sharp, community-noted price re-rating in mid-2026. FY26 and Q1 FY27 results have since sustained the inflection.
community_signal: Ravsins (untracked but detailed, 3 consecutive posts) built out the Kia-contract revenue math and explicitly argued Jasch is 'eating market share' from Mayur Uniquoters domestically, citing Mayur's own PU-plant underutilisation as the flip side. Prabhat_Mohanty (trusted) confirmed in Jun 2026 that Jasch's improvement is 'more fundamental' than a peer's forex-driven result, specifically citing Q4 topline strength and the PU capacity expansion as a genuine positive demand signal, while flagging the lack of con-calls as an information-flow risk.
